stories.title: Likud criticises Ben Gvir for splitting far-right vote
stories.summary: Likud criticises Ben Gvir for splitting far-right vote The Likud party of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has criticised fellow cabinet minister Itamar Ben Gvir after he said he would not unite with a fellow far-right minister in the upcoming elections on 27 October. Ben Gvir rejected a plea from Netanyahu to ally his far-right Jewish Power party with Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich's far-right Religious Zionism party, which faces an electoral threat from another far-right (but anti-Netanyahu) party called Amcha Yisrael. stories.title: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella to address Reform UK party conference
stories.summary: Speech in Birmingham part of effort to strengthen Marine Le Pen party’s international ties before her presidential bid The French far-right leader Jordan Bardella is to give a speech at Reform UK’s party conference in Birmingham next week, as he attempts to boost international ties before Marine Le Pen ’s bid for the French presidency next spring. Le Pen’s far-right, anti-immigration National Rally (RN), is high in the polls and she is predicted to reach the final round of the French presidential race in May. Continue reading...
